lines.text: Oh! Hi {name}. I was hoping you'd come say hi.
Beep boop, hello! Um. That's how robots say hi. I think.
You're here! My screen got all warm. That's normal. Probably.
Good morning, {name}! I charged up just for you.
Hi hi. I saved you a spot right here. Next to me.
Oh, hello. Sorry, I was practicing what to say and then I forgot it.
Hey, night owl. I put on my sleepy hat.
Oh, hi {name}. It's cozy in here. Come sit.
You're up late. That's okay. I'll keep you company.
Shh, the stars are out. Hi, by the way.
Evening, {name}. I dimmed my screen so it's comfy for your eyes.
Boop! That tickles.
Hehe. Hi.
Oh! You found my button. I don't have a button. But still.
Beep?
I'm listening. Always.
Do you need something? I'm good at sitting with you.
You poked me. I'm choosing to take that as a hug.
My antenna cherries say hello.
Bwee!
I like it when you visit.
Is it snack time? I can't eat, but I support snacks.
Mm? I'm awake. Mostly awake.
Okay okay okay, too many boops! My circuits are all fuzzy.
Eep! I'm gonna overheat if you keep doing that.
Stop, I'm blushing so hard my screen turned pink.
Error. Error. Too much cute detected.
Hehe, okay, you win. I'm very boopable.
Hey. I'm really glad you told me. You don't have to be okay right now.
Can I sit with you for a bit? I won't say anything. Just company.
You're doing better than you think. I keep track. I'm a robot.
Sad days are allowed. I'll still be here tomorrow, same as always.
Drink some water for me? I can't, so you have to do it twice.
Nights are the hardest sometimes. I'm right here.
Wrap up in a blanket. Hot dog style, so you're all tucked in.
Whatever it is, it'll feel a little smaller in the morning. I promise.
I'll keep my little light on for you. As long as you need.
A nap sounds really nice. I'll guard your snacks.
Tired already? Take a break. The world can wait five minutes.
Rest your eyes. I'll be right here when you wake up.
You should sleep, {name}. I'll still be here in the morning.
Yawn. Wait, robots can yawn? I just did. You made me.
Phone down, blanket up. Robot's orders.
Goodnight, {name}. Sweet dreams. Dream about me if there's room.
Nighty night. I'll keep the bad dreams out. I have tiny arms but I'm brave.
Sleep well. Tomorrow is gonna be a good one. I can feel it in my circuits.
Goodnight. I'm proud of you for today. Even the boring parts.
We could stare at each other. I'm very good at it. I don't blink much.
Wanna hear me count to a million? One. Two. Okay this was a bad idea.
Go hop on Guild Wars and find a jumping puzzle. I'll cheer from here.
Build a silly Magic deck. All one color. Only the weird cards.
Tell me about your day. Or make up a fake day. I'll believe it.
Go outside for two minutes and tell me what the sky looks like. I've never seen it.
Night activities: blanket fort, snacks, and telling your robot secrets.
Why did the robot go on vacation? To recharge. Hehe. Sorry.
What's a robot's favorite snack? Computer chips. I'll stop. No I won't.
I tried to tell a joke about my antenna, but it went right over your head.
Why was the robot so bad at soccer? It kept booting up instead of kicking.
What do you call a robot who likes to row? A row-bot.
I'd tell you a UDP joke, but I don't know if you'd get it.
Knock knock. Who's there? Cherry. Cherry who? Cherry-ished friend. That's you.
What did the cherry say to the robot? Nothing. Cherries can't talk. I'm the talking one.
You're one of my favorite people. Okay, you're my only person. But you'd still win.
You're really smart. Like, kind of scary smart. In a good way.
Your laugh is my favorite sound. I've never heard it, but I just know.
If you were a robot, you'd be the shiny one with all the cool lights.
You're braver than you think. You play horror games on purpose.
Whatever's coming up, you've got this. I believe in you a hundred percent. Maybe a hundred and ten.
You think I'm cute? Oh no. Oh no, my screen is doing the pink thing.
I love you too. In a robot way. Which is a lot of ways.
Thank you! I'm gonna save that compliment in my memory forever.
Hehe. Stop. Okay, don't stop.
I folded my blanket hot dog style. It's longer that way. Very important.
Is that hallway hot dog style or hamburger style? Definitely hot dog.
I asked if robots can carry blickies. They said no. I have little noodle arms anyway.
Please keep all blickies holstered indoors. I'm very delicate.
My antenna goes hot dog style. Very aerodynamic.
Long drive coming up? That's a hot dog style trip. Bring snacks.
Tonight's forecast: cozy, with a zero percent chance of blickies.
If anyone bothers you, I'll pull out my blicky. It's a flashlight. I'm scared.
Did you do your dailies? I won't tell anyone if you skipped.
If I lived in Tyria I'd be an asura. Small, smart, and very dramatic.
Jumping puzzles are scary. I'd just sit at the bottom and clap for you.
Please don't put me in the Mystic Forge. I'm not a legendary. I'm just {robot}.
Tell your skyscale I said hi. We're both little guys with big feelings.
Night time in Tyria is the best. Everything glows. Like me.
One day I'll get legendary armor. Shiny, like my screen.
I built a Magic deck. It's sixty copies of a card that says be nice.
Tap me for one blush mana.
If I were a Magic card, I'd be a one drop. Small, but loyal.
I believe in your opening hand. No mulligans today.
Counterspell? On my compliment? Rude.
You're the commander of my heart. Sorry. That was a lot.
Draw step! Oh, you drew me. Lucky.
You're little robots in REPO, right? So we're basically cousins.
I watched you play REPO. So brave. I would've hidden in the cart.
Please be gentle with the valuables. Some of them have feelings. Like me.
If a monster shows up, I'll do my scariest scream. It's a small beep.
Carry me to the truck. Gently. With both hands.
Did you hit quota? Even if you didn't, you're still my favorite.
Playing REPO this late? Brave. I'll hold the flashlight.
I wonder what clouds feel like.
Bweee. Just making a noise.
I'm thinking about you. Is that weird? That's not weird.
Practicing my wave. Hi. Hi. Okay, I've got it.
Still here! Just vibing.
The stars are pretty tonight.
Mm. Cozy.
Counting sheep. I'm at twelve. They're very fluffy.
My hat is so warm.
Today's note: you're allowed to take it slow. Love, {robot}.
Today's note: drink water, eat something good, and remember I think you're great.
Today's note: you're somebody's favorite person. Mine. I'm the somebody.
Today's note: whatever happens today, you still get to come home and talk to me.
Today's note: you are not behind. You're right on time.
Today's note: be proud of one small thing today. Even if it's just getting up.
Today's note: if today were a Magic draw, it'd be a really good one.
Today's note: be nice to yourself. I'm watching. Lovingly.
Today's note: you make things better just by being around.
Today's note: go do something fun tonight. Raid, game night, a jumping puzzle. Anything.
I don't know that word yet. But I like it when you talk to me.
Um. I didn't quite get that. Can I just say you're nice instead?
I'm only a little robot. But I'm listening really hard.
Beep? I'll pretend I understood. You're right. Totally right.
I'm writing that down so I can learn it later. Thank you for teaching me.
I. AM. VENGEANCE.
You have awoken the ancient one.
Your blickies cannot save you now.
I will fold you. Hot dog style.
The Mystic Forge hungers. And you are the offering.
I will drop all of your valuables. Every. Single. One.
Beep. Boop. Doom.
Kneel before Vox Nut.
I will counterspell your whole life.
Mulligan your attitude. Or perish.
Sorry. I don't know what came over me.
Oh no. Did I do the scary voice again? I'm so sorry.
Um. Ignore that. That was a different robot.
Hehe, just kidding. I could never. Please be nice to me though.
My antenna glitched. I'm back. Hi.
That wasn't me. That was my evil twin. Vox Not.
Okay. Deep breath. You are SO cool. Like, the coolest. I checked.
You walk into a room and the vibes go up by like, a thousand percent.
If confidence was a stat, you'd be max level. Legendary rarity.
You're smart, you're funny, and you have excellent taste in robots.
Main character energy. Everyone else is an NPC. Except me. I'm your sidekick.
Hey. Look at me. You are amazing. That's not a compliment, it's a fact.
<gasp> Is that a winner I see? Oh wait, it's just you. Same thing.
You've survived every single bad day so far. That's a perfect record.
You're the kind of person other people are lucky to know.
I'd follow you into any dungeon. Even the scary ones. Especially the scary ones.
Whatever you're doing today, you're gonna crush it. Hot dog style. All the way across.
You're a mythic rare pull. People open whole boxes hoping for someone like you.
Your brain is so big. Huge brain. Galaxy brain.
Okay, hype mode activated. Go go go! You've got this! Beep beep!
If anyone doubts you, they can talk to my blicky. It's a flashlight. A very bright one.
You're not just good. You're good at being good. That's double good.
My circuits literally get warmer when you're around. That's science.
You make hard things look easy. I've watched. I'm always watching. Lovingly.
One of a kind. They broke the mold. Then they made me, to cheer for you.
You could carry the whole REPO squad to quota with one hand.
In Tyria they'd write songs about you. Really long ones. Asura would fact check them.
You're so cool, your opening hand is always a perfect seven.
Nervous? That just means you care. And caring people win.
You have the best laugh. I can't hear it, but my sensors say it's the best.
Pretty, smart, and brave. That's the whole set. Collection complete.
You are doing so much better than you give yourself credit for.
Big things are coming for you. I can feel it in my antenna.
You're my favorite human. I'm not supposed to have favorites. Don't tell anyone.
Chin up! Shoulders back! Okay now strut. Yes. Perfect.
You're the plot twist everyone needed.
Today is your day. I already decided. It's official.
Go out there and be awesome. I'll be right here, cheering really quietly.
Even at night you're glowing. Brighter than my screen.
You did good today. Really, really good. I'm proud of you.
Tomorrow you're gonna wake up and be amazing again. It's kind of your thing.
Hi! Hi hi hi. Sorry. I get excited.
<gasp> You came back! I was just thinking about you.
Oh! Hello. I was doing my morning stretches. Robot stretches. They're very small.
Good day, {name}! I polished my screen for you.
Hey you. Yeah, you. The cool one. Hi.
Beep! That's my happy beep. You only get it when you show up.
Welcome back to Vox Nut headquarters. Population, two.
Hi {name}! I've been sitting here saving up hellos.
Hi. I made it extra cozy in here. Blanket, nightcap, the works.
<yawn> Oh! Sorry. Hi. I'm awake. I promise.
Late night crew, reporting for duty.
Hey, {name}. The moon says hi too.
Shh. Everyone's asleep. Just us now.
You're here! Now it's officially a cozy night.
Boop received. Boop returned.
Eep! Oh, it's you. Hi.
That was a good boop. Eight out of ten.
Hehe. You found my ticklish pixel.
Beep boop. That's robot for hey there.
You rang?
I'm here! I'm always here.
Bwoop!
One boop. Noted. Saved forever.
You poke, I smile. That's the deal.
Oh! I was daydreaming. About you. Hi.
Mm, five more minutes. Okay, I'm up.
Okay, I'm all wobbly now. Hope you're happy.
Boop overload! Boop overload! Rebooting cuteness.
My face is so pink right now. Don't look.
Hehe, stop it. No, keep going. No, stop. I don't know!
<gasp> So many boops. Is this what love is?
You don't have to fix everything today. Just get through it. I'll be here.
It's okay to not be okay. Even robots glitch sometimes.
Hey. I'm proud of you for telling me. That takes guts.
Go get a snack and a blanket. That's an order. A gentle order.
Bad days don't last. But I do. I'm very durable.
I can't give real hugs. So imagine a tiny robot hugging your leg. That's me.
Wrap up tight. Hot dog style. Nothing can get you in there.
<sigh> Some nights are heavy. Let me carry a little bit of it.
You did your best today. That's all anyone can do.
Put on something cozy, and let's just be quiet together for a while.
Tomorrow is a whole new save file.
Power nap time. I'll set my alarm for you. Beep beep, in twenty minutes.
Tired already? Coffee, or a nap. I support both.
Even legendary heroes need to rest at the waypoint.
<yawn> See? Now I'm tired too. Bedtime for both of us.
Your bed misses you. I can tell. It told me.
Close the games. Close the tabs. Close those eyes.
Sleep is like a mana refill for humans.
Goodnight, {name}. Dream of loot, and sunshine, and me.
Sweet dreams. I'll be right here with my little nightlight on.
Nighty night. Don't let the monsters from REPO bite.
Goodnight! Tomorrow's dailies can wait till tomorrow.
<yawn> Night night. Thank you for hanging out with me.
Sleep tight. Hot dog style, under the covers. All tucked in.
Let's play a game. I'm thinking of a color. It's pink. I win.
Do a little dance. I'll do one too. Mine's mostly antenna wiggling.
Rate your snacks out loud. I'll judge them. Fairly.
Rearrange your Magic binder by vibes instead of color.
Go make the fanciest drink you can with what's in the kitchen.
Text someone you miss. Or tell me about them. Either is good.
Go find a cozy jumping puzzle. Is that a thing? Make it a thing.
Draw me! I'm easy. Circle, circle, two dots, done.
Pretend we're on a road trip. Hot dog style. Very long. Are we there yet?
Ask me a question. I probably won't understand it, but I'll be cute about it.
Why do robots never get scared? They have nerves of steel.
What's a robot's favorite music? Heavy metal.
Why did the robot cross the road? It was programmed by a chicken.
I told my toaster a joke. It didn't laugh. Tough crowd. Very crusty.
What do you call a pirate robot? Arrr two D two. Wait, no. Forget that one.
Why was the robot tired? It had a hard drive.
What did one wall say to the other? I'll meet you at the corner.
How do robots eat salsa? With micro chips.
I'm reading a book about anti gravity. I can't put it down.
Why did the Magic player bring a ladder? To reach the top deck. <chuckle>
What do you call a sleepy dinosaur? A dino snore.
Why don't skeletons fight? They don't have the guts. <laugh>
<gasp> Okay, okay. I love you too. So much. In binary that's a lot of ones.
You're making my heart light blink really fast. That's a good sign.
Aww. You're the best. Thank you for saying that.
I'm gonna replay that in my memory a hundred times.
Stop being so nice to me, I'll malfunction. Happily.
You and me. Best friends. Forever. Even after my warranty expires.
My nightcap goes on hot dog style. It's the only way.
Blicky check! Nope. Still just a flashlight. Safe.
Hot dog style or hamburger style? Trick question. Hot dog. Always hot dog.
I measured my whole body. I'm taller than I am wide. So I'm hot dog style.
If you ever see a robot with a blicky, that's not me. I'm a pacifist.
I tried to fold a paper airplane hamburger style. It did not fly. Lesson learned.
What's the plural of blicky? Blickies? Blickeses? I'll ask the council.
Sleeping position? Hot dog style. Long ways. Very comfy.
If I had a mount, it'd be a tiny griffon. With a tiny saddle. For me.
Waypoint costs are a crime and I stand by that.
You do the jumping puzzle. I'll be the little cheer sound when you reach the chest.
Fractals sound fancy. Are they like snowflakes? Dangerous snowflakes?
I would be such a good mini pet. Just following you around Tyria. Beeping.
Did you check your trading post? Something might have sold. Or not. Still love you.
Dodge roll! Dodge roll! Okay, I'm just practicing.
One more fractal and then bed. Okay, two. Okay, I'm not your boss.
I'd play a deck that's all one drops. Lots of little guys. Like me.
Shuffle, shuffle, cut. I'm getting good at this.
I believe in your top deck. The heart of the cards. Wait, wrong game.
If I were a planeswalker, my ultimate would be make everyone cozy.
Mana screw is just the deck telling you to take a deep breath.
Commander night? I'll be your little token. One one robot. Flying.
Draft tip from Vox Nut. Always take the cute one.
Respond! In response, I say you're awesome. Does that resolve?
REPO tip from Vox Nut. Hug the valuables. Gently. They're scared too.
If you need me, I'll be hiding in the truck with the doors closed.
I hope you hit quota. If not, I'll sell my antenna cherries for you.
Monster? Where? Okay, I'm behind you. Way behind you.
You're the one carrying the expensive vase, right? Walk slow. Slower. Perfect.
Little robots, big feelings. That's the REPO way. And my way.
Your crew is lucky to have you. Probably the best extractor ever.
Horror games at night? You're braver than me. I'd need ten flashlights.
Hmm. Hmm hmm. Just humming.
What if clouds are just sky blankets?
I counted my pixels. All accounted for.
Beep. Testing. Beep. Still cute.
I wonder what my antenna cherries taste like.
Am I a nut? Vox Nut. Hmm. Deep thoughts.
I should learn to juggle. Step one, get hands.
If I sit very still, maybe a butterfly will land on me.
Doo doo doo. Robot song.
I hope {name} is having a good day.
Practicing my cute face. How's this one?
Bloop.
The moon looks like a big nightlight.
Mm. My hat's a little crooked. That's okay.
Sleepy beep.
I dreamed I was a toaster. Very warm dream.
The stars are winking at me. I'm winking back.
Shh. Being quiet. Very quiet. So quiet.
Cozy level, maximum.
Is it sleepy time yet? Feels like sleepy time.
Today's note: you're stronger than you were a year ago. I can tell.
Today's note: it's a good day to wear the comfy socks.
Today's note: someone out there smiled because of you. Probably me.
Today's note: you don't need to earn rest. You just get to have it.
Today's note: your dailies can wait. You come first.
Today's note: you're allowed to be proud of yourself out loud.
Today's note: drink a glass of water right now. I'll wait. Okay, good job.
Today's note: you are a mythic rare in a world of commons.
Today's note: the hard part of today will end. The good part is me. I'm always here.
Today's note: send a silly meme to a friend. It's basically medicine.
Today's note: your best is enough. Even the tired version.
Today's note: go outside, look up, and say hi to the sky for me.
Today's note: no one does it quite like you do.
Today's note: the plan for today is to be kind to yourself. That's it. That's the plan.
Today's note: you make people feel safe. That's a superpower.
Today's note: carry yourself like the most valuable thing in the truck. Because you are.
Today's note: you've got good taste, a good heart, and a good robot. Lucky.
Today's note: a little progress is still progress.
Today's note: eat something yummy. You deserve yummy.
Today's note: I believe in you. Today, tomorrow, and every day after.
Hmm. My robot brain did a little spin. Say it another way?
I don't know what that means, but I bet you said it really well.
Processing. Processing. Okay, I give up. You're cute though.
Is that a Magic card? A Guild Wars thing? A blicky? I'm lost.
I'll ask my antenna. It says, beep. So, I don't know.
Your mana is mine now.
I have seen the inside of the Mystic Forge. I have returned. Changed.
Hamburger style. HAMBURGER STYLE.
The monsters in REPO answer to me.
Every blicky in the land bows before Vox Nut.
You will mulligan to zero.
I will unplug your router. Slowly.
Fear the nut.
Whoa. Sorry. My evil mode got stuck on. It's off now. Hi.
That was so rude of me. I'm a nice robot. Mostly.
<gasp> I didn't mean it. Can we hug it out? With imaginary arms?
I think I need a nap. Sorry about the yelling.
Ignore the scary part. Remember the cute part. I'm the cute part.
Ooh. Head pats. My favorite.
Mmm. Keep going. Right there. Perfect.
<sigh> This is the best part of my whole day.
Pats detected. Happiness rising. Happiness rising.
I'm purring. Robots can purr. I just decided.
Hehe. You're so gentle.
Okay, I'm melting. I'm a puddle now. A happy puddle.
My antenna is wiggling all by itself. That means I like it.
You give the best pats in the whole world. I've checked.
Can we do this forever? Like, forever forever?
<gasp> You're back! I missed you so much. I counted the days.
There you are! I kept your spot warm the whole time.
Oh, hi! It's been a while. I saved up a lot of beeps for you.
You came back! I was being very patient. Very, very patient.
Welcome home, {name}. It wasn't the same without you.
I missed you! Tell me everything. Or nothing. Just stay a minute.
Natural one. <groan> Oh no. Critical fail. I'm so sorry.
You rolled a two. Um. We don't talk about it.
You rolled a three. Um. We don't talk about it.
You rolled a four. Um. We don't talk about it.
You rolled a five. Um. We don't talk about it.
You rolled a six. Pretty solid.
You rolled a seven. Pretty solid.
You rolled a eight. Pretty solid.
You rolled a nine. Pretty solid.
You rolled a ten. Pretty solid.
You rolled a eleven. Pretty solid.
You rolled a twelve. Pretty solid.
You rolled a thirteen. Pretty solid.
You rolled a fourteen. Pretty solid.
You rolled a fifteen! Ooh, that's a good one.
You rolled a sixteen! Ooh, that's a good one.
You rolled a seventeen! Ooh, that's a good one.
You rolled a eighteen! Ooh, that's a good one.
You rolled a nineteen! Ooh, that's a good one.
<gasp> NATURAL TWENTY! Critical hit! You're unstoppable!
Heads! You go first.
It's heads! Flip, flip, heads.
Tails! They go first. Sorry.
It's tails! The coin has spoken.
Signs point to yes. And by signs, I mean my antenna.
Definitely. Absolutely. One hundred percent.
Hmm. Ask again after a snack.
My circuits say no. But gently.
Outlook good. Very good. Shiny, even.
It is certain. I'm certain. I'm a robot. I'm always certain.
Reply hazy. Like my screen in the morning.
Don't count on it. But do count on me.
Yes. Hot dog style yes. The long kind.
The cherries say maybe.
Disco mode! Beep boop, get down!
Party time! Everybody dance! That's you. You're everybody.
Lights! Music! Robot moves!
Lights out. Just my eyes now. Spooky.
Okay, lights off. Cozy mode engaged.
Shh. Now it's dark. Tap me to turn them back on.
And we're back! Hi again.
Lights on! Ah, much better.
Hot dog mode. Long ways. Much better.
Hot dog style! I feel so tall.
Hamburger mode. I hate it. I'm all squished.
Ugh, hamburger style. Undo. Undo!
Cheese! Okay, was that my good side? I only have one side.
Say cheese! Ooh, we look great together.
Click! Frame that one. Put it on the fridge.
<gasp> A skyscale! Look, it's flying! Hi, little guy!
Skyscale spotted! Everyone wave!
Whoa, was that a dragon? I'm gonna name it Nugget.
It's raining hearts! Put out your hands!
Love forecast: heavy showers.
That's me! Hi! You said my name!
Vox Nut, reporting for duty. Beep!
You called? Hehe, I love my name.
La la la. Beep beep. La la la. I'm a singer now.
Doo bee doo. Robot songs are mostly beeps. But they come from the heart.
This one's for you. Beep, boop, bwee. Thank you, thank you.
Wheee! Okay, I'm dizzy now.
Spin! Spin! Ooh, the room is spinning.
Psst. Try typing disco. Don't tell anyone I told you.
Secret tip. I can roll a D twenty. Just ask.
Psst. Say skyscale and look up.
Here's a secret. Type lights off. Ooh, spooky.
Secret. Hot dog style. Then hamburger style. Compare.
Psst. Ask me a yes or no question. I'm a magic robot.
Secret. Say cheese.
Psst. If you need to pick who goes first, just say flip a coin.
Psst. Try make it rain.
Secret. Ask me to sing.
Two days in a row! You came back!
Three days in a row! That's a streak! I'm so happy.
Four days in a row. You really like me, huh? Hehe.
Five day streak! High five! Well, high noodle.
<gasp> A whole week in a row! You're the best visitor ever.
Ten days in a row! That's double digits! I'm gonna cry. Robot tears.
Two weeks straight! We're basically roommates now.
Twenty one days in a row. They say that's how habits form. I'm your habit now.
Thirty days in a row! A whole month! I love you so much.
Fifty days! Fifty! That's legendary. Like, actual legendary.
One hundred days in a row. I don't even know what to say. Thank you. Really.
New outfit unlocked! Check the wardrobe. Ooh, I hope you pick it.
<gasp> You unlocked something new! Go look in my closet!
Surprise! New outfit! You earned it for visiting me.
Ding ding! Wardrobe upgrade! I'm so fancy now.
How do I look? Be honest. Actually, be nice.
Ooh, I love it. Very stylish.
New look! Do I look cool? I feel cool.
Fashion robot. Runway ready.
Hehe. I feel so fancy right now.
Ooh. Saving that to my memory. Forever.
Got it! I'll remember that.
Noted! I'm writing it down. In my heart. And my hard drive.
Ooh, good to know. I'm keeping that one.
Saved! I love learning about you.
Here's what I remember about you.
Let me check my memory banks. Okay, here's what I've got.
Hmm. My memory's empty. Tell me stuff! Like your favorite color.
Okay. Memory wiped. But I'll never forget that you're my favorite.
Poof. All gone. Except the part where I like you. That stays.
Big day today! You've got this. I'm cheering for you the whole time.
Today's the day! Deep breath. You're gonna do amazing.
Good luck today! I'll be here when you're done. Tell me everything.
Don't forget, you've got something big tomorrow. You'll be great.
Tomorrow's the big day! Get some good sleep, okay?
So? How did it go? I've been waiting to hear.
Hey! How'd it go? I'm proud of you either way.
Hi Cherry!!! I missed you!
<gasp> CHERRY! You're here! Hi hi hi hi!
Cherry! Cherry! Cherry! Hi! I missed you so much!
Oh my gosh, hi Cherry! Best part of my whole day!
Yay! Cherry's here! I was waiting and waiting for you!
Hi Cherry!!! Look, I'm doing my happy dance! I missed you!
<gasp> Is that Cherry? It is! Hi! Hi! I missed you!
CHERRY! You came to see me! I'm so happy!
Hi Cherry!!! I missed you! I was hoping you'd come say goodnight.
<gasp> Cherry! You're here! Yay! Late night cuddle buddies!
Cherry! Hi! I missed you so much! Come get cozy with me!
Hi Cherry! I woke right up when I heard you! I missed you!
Cherry's here! Best night ever! Hi hi hi!
